evidence: Human semen was collected at the Meander Medical Center (Amersfoort, the Netherlands) from healthy vasectomized man following a 3 month postoperative period.

Human semen was collected at the Meander Medical Center (Amersfoort, the Netherlands) from healthy vasectomized man following a 3 month postoperative period.
EV in seminal plasma are in majority originating from prostate epithelial cells, and hence are also referred to as prostasomes.
